title: Learning a Prayer Time App
paragraphs: Reza moves to a new city for work and no longer knows the exact prayer times without checking a mosque schedule, so a colleague suggests he download a simple prayer time app on his phone.

At first, Reza finds the app slightly confusing, with settings for location and calculation methods he does not fully understand. He spends ten minutes adjusting it until the times match his local mosque.
A week later, he shows the same app to his roommate, who has been guessing prayer times based on the sunlight outside his window, and both of them agree it saves them from a lot of confusion.

Within a week, checking the app becomes second nature, and it quietly reminds him throughout busy workdays. Reza appreciates how a small piece of technology can support something as personal as his daily prayers.
